title: Residual Modeling for High-Fidelity Learned Compression of Scientific Data
abstract: arXiv:2606.05389v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Lossy compression is essential for massive spatiotemporal data from scientific simulations. Learned compressors can achieve high compression ratios at moderate accuracy targets, but their aggregate reconstruction losses do not guarantee accuracy for each block. Existing Guaranteed Autoencoder (GAE) methods add a per-block residual correction by retaining SVD/PCA-style coefficients until the target is met. This works at moderate tolerances, but in the high-fidelity regime with block-level NRMSE from 10^-6 to 10^-4, the number of retained coefficients grows quickly and the correction stream dominates the total rate.   We propose a residual-centric view: the learned residual is structurally different from the original scientific field and should be coded with a representation designed for that residual. translated_title: 高保真科学数据学习压缩的残差建模
translated_abstract: 有损压缩对于来自科学模拟的大规模时空数据至关重要。学习型压缩器在中等精度目标下可以实现高压缩比，但其聚合重建损失无法保证每个块的精度。现有的保证自编码器方法通过保留SVD/PCA风格的系数，直到满足目标，来添加逐块残差校正。这在中等容差下有效，但在块级NRMSE从10^-6到10^-4的高保真范围内，保留的系数数量迅速增长，校正流主导了总比特率。我们提出一种以残差为中心的观点：学习型残差在结构上与原始科学场不同，应使用为该残差设计的表示进行编码。我们引入了两种残差编码器。LBRC是一种确定性、无需训练的流水线，它将学习型残差自适应量化到...
tldr: 提出一种以残差为中心的编码方法，通过为学习型残差设计专用表示（如LBRC），在高保真科学数据压缩中避免残差流主导比特率，从而提升精度与压缩效率。
en_tdlr: Propose a residual-centric coding approach that designs dedicated representations (e.g., LBRC) for learned residuals, preventing the residual stream from dominating bitrate in high-fidelity scientific data compression, thereby improving accuracy and efficiency.
